title: Sum of Subsequence Widths
summary: Calculate the sum of widths for all non-empty subsequences of an integer array, where the width is the difference between the maximum and minimum elements in each subsequence.
statement: Calculate the sum of widths for all non-empty subsequences of an integer array, where the width is the difference between the maximum and minimum elements in each subsequence. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: The width of a nonempty subsequence is maximum minus minimum.
Sum widths over all index subsequences.
hints: Sort so each value’s rank determines how often it is a maximum or minimum.
At rank i, its signed coefficient is 2^i-2^(n-1-i).
The symmetric loop accumulates both roles with one growing power.
Every subsequence contributes its maximum once and its minimum once with opposite sign.
editorial: Every subsequence contributes its maximum once and its minimum once with opposite sign.

tests.explanation: Singleton widths are zero and the four larger subsequences contribute 1+1+2+2=6.
Every subsequence has equal minimum and maximum, so return zero.
